mapper.select: SELECT (case when wu.SHORT_NAME IS NULL OR wu.SHORT_NAME = '' OR crew.SHORT_NAME IS NULL OR crew.SHORT_NAME = '' then crew.name else CONCAT(wu.SHORT_NAME, crew.SHORT_NAME) end) as unit_crew_short_name ,record.id --,record.crew_id ,record.DATE, record.MEMBER_NAME, record.SUM_RATIO, record.WORKER_NUM, record.RATE ,crew.id crew_id --,crew.UNIT_ID crew_unit_id --,crew.NAME crew_name --,crew.TYPE crew_type --,crew.SHORT_NAME crew_short_name FROM ( select * from OMS_ZF.CREW where NAME not like '%分部%' and NAME not like '%项目中心%' ) crew LEFT JOIN OMS_ZF.WORK_UNIT wu on crew.UNIT_ID = wu.ID LEFT JOIN ( select * from oms_zf.crew_work_load_rate_day_record where DATE >= #{startDate} and DATE < #{endDate} and MEMBER_NAME in ('工作负责人', '作业人员') ) record on record.CREW_ID = crew.ID order by record.DATE
